grammar: Full-input parse; comma or dot decimal, ASCII/Unicode minus, optional plus, matching optional unit. Exactly three fractional digits are accepted if the integer part is zero (0.095, 0,105, -0.005); nonzero integer plus exactly three digits remains ambiguous grouping and clarifies. Grouping, exponent, fractions, additional numbers and prose never prefix-accepted. No rescaling.
arithmetic: Exact BigInt decimal rational; inclusive comparisons. M10.01 keeps its exact previous statuses, grammar, units and tolerances.
